LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS (LISTENING AND SPEAKING) 5.1.1 ENVIRONMENTAL AWARENESS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: MY NEIGHBORHOOD Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning 
Topic 5.1: Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 5.1.1 Environmental awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 5.1.1 Environmental awareness, part of MY NEIGHBORHOOD Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning  in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: where they take on different roles representing structures in the neighborhood. 1. Which are the different things in our environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 5.1.1 Environmental awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: reflection on own skill as learner creates a small model or diagram of a neighborhood in the classroom.

● Creativity and imagination: communications and self expression skills as learner creates a collage using pictures from

magazines or printed images of different structures in the neighborhood.

● Communication and Collaboration: signing skills as learner interacts with others in talking about things found in the

neighbourhood.

Values:
● Responsibility: Diligence as learner cares for some of the things found in the environment like pets, plants.

● Respect: Patience as learner patiently takes turns with others in talking about things found in the neighborhood.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental awareness as learner learns about things found in the neighbourhood and their uses.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Environmental awareness promotes environmental activities as learners take care of the environment.

Suggested Learning Resources:

, assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers, neighborhood map, drawings, pictures,

flashcards, community collage, story books
